firm_data.firm_description: O’Connor & Partners is a New York personal injury law firm dedicated to maximizing compensation for the people we represent. Our attorneys have years of experience — not to mention a record of fighting, winning, and making a difference in our clients’ lives.
notable_facts: The firm advances the costs of litigation.
They do not charge clients a fee unless they get them money.
Cases have been featured on television on the Today Show and Anderson 360 and in The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times and the New York Journal.

email.subject: AI for O'Connor & Partners, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

Your firm advances litigation costs for clients while maintaining a contingency model, which means precision matters on every case. With 8 attorneys covering everything from auto accidents to medical malpractice, you're competing against larger firms without their overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Kingston to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
